description: Fix a lock-ordering deadlock: two concurrent transfers lock the same pair of accounts in opposite orders across a 50 ms in-flight window. The gate runs the deadly pair with a join timeout; the fix must acquire the two locks in a deterministic (id-sorted) order while keeping the window.

criteria: transfer acquires the two account locks in a deterministic order (id-sorted helper) so opposite-direction transfers cannot interleave, the 50 ms in-flight window is preserved, and the gate's opposite-direction pair completes within the timeout with exact balances - not by removing the window or shortening the timeout path.
